member_names: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit
title: RNA-seq and qPCR Analysis in DBY12007 Organism
summary: This cluster is centered around the organism DBY12007, which undergoes the process of HAP1. RNA-seq is performed using the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing system and the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit. The WRS method is used on DBY12007, involving the NanoDrop One spectrophotometry and STAR. The DESeq2 gene_or_protein is performed on WRS. Additionally, qPCR is carried out with the ABI StepOnePlus system and PowerUp SYBR Green Master Mix. Chemicals like Dissolved oxygen and Redox cycle are associated with YMC, while GSEA and emmeans are related to gene_or_protein functions.
